purpose: The 250-story Interactive Story Library program ledger (25 parts x 10 teaching points, operator-commissioned). One row per commissioned story slot. gate-library.js enforces registry<->story consistency and cross-library variety over rows with a storyId. premise/setting are filled when a story is built. status: open -> in_progress -> shipped.

rows.label: Count objects 1–5
rows.premise: help Shelly the hermit crab gather and count treasures to decorate her new shell home

rows.label: Identify basic shapes: circle, square, triangle
rows.premise: help Bo the beaver fix his broken cart by fitting the circle, square, and triangle parts back

rows.label: Big vs. small
rows.premise: help Poppy the hedgehog harvest her garden by telling the big vegetables from the small ones

rows.label: Same vs. different
rows.premise: follow the matching trail signs with Hazel the squirrel to reach her treehouse party

rows.label: Sort objects by one attribute (color)
rows.premise: sort Willa the duck's wind-blown washing back by color

rows.label: Match identical objects (one-to-one matching)
rows.premise: match every twin in Milo the penguin's tipped-over winter chest before the sledding trip

rows.label: Identify primary colors
rows.premise: wake the rainbow's colors with Kiko the chameleon after the rain

rows.label: More vs. fewer (visual comparison)
rows.premise: help Willa share feeding-time snacks by spotting which group has more and which has fewer
